text:
Type: colorful button-print kids' rug
Use: playing and sitting on the floor; kids' room, nursery, playroom
Style: retro, contemporary
Materials: short dense low pile
Colors: off-white ground, red, yellow, pink, orange, green, sky and cobalt blue, black
Shape: rectangular, flat low pile, neat grid of large round sewing-button motifs, cheerful and bold, compact
Feel: playful, cheerful, bright, sweet
Goes with: white kids' furniture, light wood, bright primary accents; children's bedrooms, nurseries and playrooms

product.name: TSTRUP
product.description: The thick pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
